name: Integrated Capital Services Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1993, Integrated Capital 
Services Ltd renders services with focus 
on Business Structuring, Restructuring 
and Turnaround.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
ICSL provides corporate advisory, consulting, and accounting services, specializing in turnaround, restructuring, mergers, takeovers, and distressed asset advisory. It also assists Insolvency Professionals and is awaiting approval to register as an Insolvency Professional Entity with the IBBI.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 104 to 33.2 days.
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -6.43% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.63% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
